extracted_concepts.name: 数据收集整理
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of gathering raw information and organizing it into structured formats.

extracted_concepts.name: 简单的统计表
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Basic tabular format used to display collected data frequencies.

extracted_concepts.name: 画“正”字记录数据
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Traditional tally method using the Chinese character Zheng to count occurrences.

extracted_concepts.name: 表内除法（一）
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Introduction to division where divisors and quotients fall within multiplication tables 2-6.

extracted_concepts.name: 平均分
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dividing a total quantity into equal parts or groups.

extracted_concepts.name: 除法的初步认识
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Foundational concept introducing division as the inverse operation of multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: 用 2-6 的乘法口诀求商
aliases: Using Multiplication Tables 2-6 to Find Quotients
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method to solve division problems by recalling corresponding multiplication facts.

extracted_concepts.name: 图形的运动（一）
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Study of geometric transformations including symmetry, translation, and rotation.

extracted_concepts.name: 轴对称
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Property where a figure can be folded along a line so both halves match perfectly.

extracted_concepts.name: 平移
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sliding a shape in a specific direction without rotating or resizing it.

extracted_concepts.name: 旋转
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Turning a shape around a fixed point or axis.

extracted_concepts.name: 表内除法（二）
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Advanced division practice extending multiplication table usage to numbers 7-9.

extracted_concepts.name: 用 7-9 的乘法口诀求商
aliases: Using Multiplication Tables 7-9 to Find Quotients
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Application of higher multiplication tables to compute division results.

extracted_concepts.name: 混合运算
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Calculations involving two or more arithmetic operations in a single expression.

extracted_concepts.name: 同级运算
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operations of the same precedence level, such as addition/subtraction or multiplication/division.

extracted_concepts.name: 两级运算
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expressions combining different operation levels, like multiplication and addition.

extracted_concepts.name: 有小括号的运算
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Calculations where parentheses dictate priority, requiring inner expressions to be solved first.

extracted_concepts.name: 有余数的除法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Division scenario where the dividend is not perfectly divisible by the divisor.

extracted_concepts.name: 有余数除法的意义
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Conceptual understanding that division may leave a leftover amount smaller than the divisor.

extracted_concepts.name: 余数要比除数小
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fundamental rule stating the remainder must always be strictly less than the divisor.

extracted_concepts.name: 万以内数的认识
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Comprehensive study of number sense, place value, and magnitude up to 10,000.

extracted_concepts.name: 1000 以内数的认识
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Foundational number recognition and counting skills limited to three-digit numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: 10000 以内数的认识
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Extension of number sense to four-digit numbers and the ten-thousands place.

extracted_concepts.name: 近似数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rounded value close to an exact number, used for estimation and practical measurement.

extracted_concepts.name: 克
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Metric unit of mass, typically used for measuring light objects.

extracted_concepts.name: 千克
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Metric unit of mass, equivalent to 1000 grams, used for measuring heavier items.

extracted_concepts.name: 称量
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of determining the mass of an object using a scale or balance.

extracted_concepts.name: 数学广角——推理
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dedicated instructional module focusing on developing logical deduction skills.

extracted_concepts.name: 简单的逻辑推理
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Basic deductive processes to draw valid conclusions from given premises.
